/* Fontes do Google Fonts */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400..900;1,400..900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:ital,wght@0,200..800;1,200..800&display=swap');

:root {
  /* Cores */
  --bg-absolute: #000000;
  --bg-primary: #0a0a0a;
  --bg-card: #121212;
  --bg-card-hover: #181818;
  --bg-modal: #151515;
  
  --gold-primary: #d4af37;
  --gold-light: #f3e5ab;
  --gold-dark: #aa7c11;
  --gold-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #aa7c11 0%, #d4af37 40%, #f3e5ab 75%, #aa7c11 100%);
  --gold-translucent: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  --gold-translucent-hover: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  --border-gold: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  --border-gold-focus: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.7);

  --text-primary: #f5f5f5;
  --text-secondary: #a0a0a0;
  --text-muted: #666666;
  --text-dark: #0a0a0a;

  /* Status */
  --success: #2e7d32;
  --warning: #f57c00;
  --danger: #c62828;

  /* Fontes */
  --font-title: 'Playfair Display', Didot, Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;

  /* Efeitos */
  --shadow-premium: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}

/* Reset de Estilos */
* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--gold-primary) var(--bg-primary);
}

body {
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background-image: 
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.03) 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.03) 0%, transparent 40%);
}

/* Estilização Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--gold-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--gold-light);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   LAYOUT DO APP SPA
   ========================================================================== */

.app-container {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* Sidebar Lateral */
.sidebar {
  width: 280px;
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border-right: var(--border-gold);
  padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: fixed;
  height: 100vh;
  z-index: 100;
  box-shadow: 10px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Custom Scrollbar Premium para a Sidebar */
.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}

.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--bg-absolute);
}

.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background-color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.brand {
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
}

.brand img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2));
}

.nav-menu {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.nav-item button {
  width: 100%;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.nav-item button i {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.nav-item button:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  transform: translateX(5px);
}

.nav-item.active button {
  color: var(--gold-light);
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.nav-item.active button i {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.sidebar-footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* Área de Conteúdo Principal */
.main-content {
  margin-left: 280px;
  flex-grow: 1;
  padding: 3rem;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* Seções de Conteúdo */
.app-section {
  display: none;
  animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease;
}

.app-section.active {
  display: block;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(15px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* Cabeçalhos de Seção */
.section-header {
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.section-title h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.section-title p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

/* Botoes Premium */
.btn-gold {
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
}

.btn-gold:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow), 0 6px 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37 0%, #f3e5ab 50%, #d4af37 100%);
}

.btn-outline-gold {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-outline-gold:hover {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  border: var(--border-gold-focus);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-danger {
  background: rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.1);
  color: #ff8a80;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.25);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.btn-danger:hover {
  background: #ef5350;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #ef5350;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
}

.btn-danger-outline {
  background: transparent;
  color: #ff8a80;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.25);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.btn-danger-outline:hover {
  background: #ef5350;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #ef5350;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CARDS & GRIDS (DASHBOARD)
   ========================================================================== */

.metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.metric-card {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.8rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium);
}

.metric-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  background-color: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
}

.metric-icon {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.metric-card:hover .metric-icon {
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.metric-info h3 {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.metric-info .metric-value {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* Grid de duas colunas do Dashboard */
.dashboard-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .dashboard-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.dashboard-panel {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium);
}

.panel-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.panel-header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.panel-header h2 i {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

/* Tabela Premium integrada */
.table-responsive {
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.premium-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.premium-table th {
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.03);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.premium-table td {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.premium-table tr:hover td {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  color: var(--gold-light);
}

.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.badge-low {
  background-color: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.15);
  color: #ff8a80;
  border: 1px solid rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.3);
}

.badge-ok {
  background-color: rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.15);
  color: #81c784;
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.3);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   PRECIFICAÇÃO E CADASTRO
   ========================================================================== */

.form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.form-group {
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.form-group label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.form-control {
  width: 100%;
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.form-control:focus {
  outline: none;
  border: var(--border-gold-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  background-color: #050505;
}

.input-icon-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}

.input-icon-wrapper span {
  position: absolute;
  left: 1rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.input-icon-wrapper .form-control {
  padding-left: 2.2rem;
}

/* Visualizador de Precificação em Tempo Real */
.pricing-calculator-card {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08) 0%, transparent 60%), var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium), var(--shadow-glow);
  position: sticky;
  top: 2rem;
}

.pricing-calculator-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.pricing-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.pricing-row.total {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  padding: 1.2rem 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.pricing-row.total span:last-child {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.pricing-row.profit {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #81c784;
}

.pricing-row span:first-child {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.pricing-row span:last-child {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.pricing-footer-tip {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-align: center;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   GESTÃO DE REVENDEDORAS (CONSIGNADO)
   ========================================================================== */

.split-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .split-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.list-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.list-item {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.list-item:hover {
  background-color: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
}

.list-item.selected {
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-primary);
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.list-item-info h4 {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.list-item-info p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.list-item-value {
  text-align: right;
}

.list-item-value span {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.list-item-value small {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.detail-view {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium);
}

.detail-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.detail-header h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.detail-header p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.detail-header p i {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.consign-box {
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.02);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.consign-box h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

/* Modificadores de quantidade de tabela */
.qtd-edit {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.btn-qty {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-qty:hover {
  background-color: var(--gold-primary);
  color: var(--text-dark);
}

.qty-val {
  min-width: 25px;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Tabela de acerto rápida com inputs */
.acerto-input {
  width: 60px;
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.3rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

.acerto-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   MARKETING E INSTAGRAM
   ========================================================================== */

.mkt-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: var(--border-gold);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.mkt-tab-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mkt-tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.mkt-tab-btn.active {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  border-bottom-color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Grid Responsivo para Termos de Consignação */
.termos-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .termos-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Simulador de Feed do Instagram */
.feed-planner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 3rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .feed-planner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.instagram-mockup {
  width: 360px;
  background-color: #000;
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: 40px;
  padding: 2.5rem 1.2rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium), 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
}

.ig-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1c1c1c;
  padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.ig-username {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.2rem;
}

.ig-username i {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.ig-stats-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #fff;
}

.ig-stat-num {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  display: block;
}

.ig-stat-label {
  color: #a0a0a0;
}

.ig-bio {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.ig-bio .ig-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  display: block;
}

.ig-bio a {
  color: #0095f6;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ig-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.ig-post {
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #121212, #242424);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.ig-post img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.ig-post:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.08);
  filter: brightness(0.7);
}

.ig-post-placeholder {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
}

.ig-post-placeholder span {
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.feed-instructions {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem;
}

.feed-instructions h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.post-uploader-box {
  background: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: 2px dashed rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  padding: 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.post-uploader-box:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.02);
}

.post-uploader-box i {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

/* Legendas e Ideias de Marketing */
.idea-card {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.idea-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 4px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
}

.idea-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.idea-day {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  color: var(--gold-light);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.idea-channel {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.idea-title {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.caption-box {
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.2rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  white-space: pre-line;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-top: 1rem;
  position: relative;
}

.btn-copy {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0.8rem;
  top: 0.8rem;
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-copy:hover {
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   PUBLICO TARGET & PERSONAS
   ========================================================================== */

.persona-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 2rem;
}

.persona-card {
  background-color: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium);
  position: relative;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.persona-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
}

.persona-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-bottom: 1.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.persona-avatar {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.persona-title h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}

.persona-title p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.persona-detail {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.persona-detail strong {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.persona-detail p {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   MODAIS & UTILITÁRIOS
   ========================================================================== */

.modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  z-index: 200;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.modal-backdrop.active {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.modal-card {
  width: 650px;
  max-width: 90%;
  max-height: 90vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background-color: var(--bg-modal);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium), var(--shadow-glow);
  transform: scale(0.9);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}

.modal-backdrop.active .modal-card {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.modal-title-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.modal-title-row h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.btn-close-modal {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-close-modal:hover {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.modal-footer {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
}

/* Planilhas e Integração */
.import-excel-zone {
  border: 2px dashed rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  padding: 3rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.import-excel-zone:hover {
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6);
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.02);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
}

.import-excel-zone.dragover {
  border-color: var(--gold-primary) !important;
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2), 0 0 25px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35) !important;
  transform: scale(0.99);
}

.import-excel-zone i {
  font-size: 3.5rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.import-excel-zone:hover i, .import-excel-zone.dragover i {
  transform: scale(1.15);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.8));
}

.import-excel-zone h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.import-excel-zone p {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  max-width: 320px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* Responsividade Mobile da Sidebar */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .app-container {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .sidebar {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    position: relative;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: var(--border-gold);
  }

  .brand {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .brand img {
    max-width: 250px;
  }

  .nav-menu {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }

  .nav-item button {
    padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .main-content {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   TELA DE LOGIN PREMIUM (GLASSMORPHISM PRETO & DOURADO)
   ========================================================================== */

.login-container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  background-color: #070707;
  background-image: 
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.07) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 90%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.02) 0%, transparent 70%);
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

/* Efeito de partículas de fundo decorativas no login */
.login-container::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle 1px at 15% 25%, rgba(212,175,55,0.4) 0%, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle 1px at 85% 15%, rgba(212,175,55,0.3) 0%, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle 1px at 65% 80%, rgba(212,175,55,0.25) 0%, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle 1px at 35% 70%, rgba(212,175,55,0.35) 0%, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle 1px at 90% 55%, rgba(212,175,55,0.2) 0%, transparent 1px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.login-card {
  width: 460px;
  max-width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(20,20,20,0.97) 0%, rgba(14,14,14,0.98) 100%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 3rem 2.8rem;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.05) inset,
    0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    0 0 40px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.06),
    0 1px 0 rgba(212,175,55,0.15) inset;
  text-align: center;
  animation: loginFadeIn 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  position: relative;
}

/* Linha dourada sutil no topo do card */
.login-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 15%;
  right: 15%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(212,175,55,0.6), transparent);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

@keyframes loginFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(32px) scale(0.97); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

.login-logo {
  max-width: 160px;
  margin: 0 auto 1.8rem;
}

.login-logo img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35));
}

.login-card h2 {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #aa7c11 0%, #d4af37 40%, #f3e5ab 75%, #c9a227 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.login-card > p {
  color: #7a7a7a;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.login-card .form-group label {
  color: #8a8a8a;
  text-align: left;
}

.login-card .form-control {
  background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  color: #f0f0f0;
  text-align: left;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.login-card .form-control:focus {
  background-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.04);
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.55);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,0.08), 0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
}

.login-card .form-control::placeholder {
  color: #3a3a3a;
}

.login-card .btn-gold {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b8922a 0%, #d4af37 45%, #e8c84a 70%, #c5a030 100%);
  color: #0a0a0a;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) inset;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.login-card .btn-gold:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) inset;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c5a030 0%, #e8c84a 45%, #f3d55a 70%, #d4af37 100%);
}

.login-error-box {
  background-color: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.12);
  color: #ff8a80;
  border: 1px solid rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.25);
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(198,40,40,0.6);
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: left;
}

.login-footer {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  color: #444;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  padding-top: 1.2rem;
}

/* Botão de notificações fixo no canto superior direito (na tela de login) */
#btn-notificacoes-login {
  position: fixed;
  top: 1.2rem;
  right: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 1100;
  background: rgba(14,14,14,0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.1) inset;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

#btn-notificacoes-login:hover {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(212,175,55,0.25);
  transform: scale(1.08);
}

#btn-notificacoes-login .notif-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  right: -4px;
  background: #d4af37;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 2px solid #070707;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ESTILOS ADICIONAIS DE MELHORIAS DE UX/UI (MODAIS DE CONSIGNAÇÃO E ACERTO)
   ========================================================================== */

/* Botões de atalho rápidos (Vender Tudo / Devolver Tudo) */
.btn-shortcut {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08);
  color: var(--gold-light);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-shortcut:hover {
  background: var(--gold-translucent-hover);
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-shortcut.danger {
  background: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.08);
  color: #ff8a80;
  border: 1px solid rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.25);
}

.btn-shortcut.danger:hover {
  background: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.18);
  border-color: var(--danger);
  color: #ffcdcc;
}

/* Inputs de quantidade interativos na tabela */
.acerto-input-wrapper {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: var(--bg-absolute);
  border: var(--border-gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.2rem;
}

.acerto-input-wrapper input {
  width: 45px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.acerto-input-wrapper input:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.acerto-input-wrapper .btn-input-adjust {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  border: none;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.acerto-input-wrapper .btn-input-adjust:hover {
  background: var(--gold-primary);
  color: var(--text-dark);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ESTILOS EXCLUSIVOS - TELA E MODAL DA REVENDEDORA
   ========================================================================== */

#btn-open-modal-venda-rev {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.8rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
}

#maleta-metrics-grid {
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.comissao-destaque {
  color: #81c784 !important;
}

.vendas-destaque {
  color: var(--gold-primary) !important;
}

.modal-venda-rev-card {
  width: 520px;
}

.logo-venda-rev {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.venda-rev-form-container {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.input-venda-rev-qtd {
  text-align: center;
}

.venda-rev-preview-box {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 1.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.venda-rev-preview-title {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  color: var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.venda-rev-preview-nome {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.total-venda-rev-row {
  font-weight: 700;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  padding-top: 0.8rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.total-venda-rev-row span:last-child {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.profit-venda-rev-row {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.profit-venda-rev-row span:last-child {
  color: #81c784;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.venda-rev-aviso-box {
  color: var(--danger);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  background: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.1);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

#btn-confirmar-venda-rev {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2e7d32, #43a047);
  border-color: #43a047;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

#btn-confirmar-venda-rev:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1b5e20, #2e7d32);
  border-color: #2e7d32;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   SISTEMA DE TOAST E CONFIRMAÇÃO PERSONALIZADOS (AESTHETIC PREMIUM)
   ========================================================================== */

#toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 2rem;
  right: 2rem;
  z-index: 2200;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  max-width: 380px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.custom-toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  transform: translateX(120%);
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275), opacity 0.4s ease;
  opacity: 0;
}

.custom-toast.show {
  transform: translateX(0);
  opacity: 1;
}

.custom-toast.success {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--success);
}
.custom-toast.success i {
  color: #81c784;
}

.custom-toast.error {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--danger);
}
.custom-toast.error i {
  color: #ef9a9a;
}

.custom-toast.warning {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--warning);
}
.custom-toast.warning i {
  color: #ffb74d;
}

.custom-toast.info {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--gold-primary);
}
.custom-toast.info i {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.custom-toast-message {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Modal de Confirmação Customizado */
#custom-confirm-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  z-index: 2100;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.confirm-card {
  width: 400px;
  max-width: 90%;
  background: var(--bg-modal);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.2rem 2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium), var(--shadow-glow);
  text-align: center;
  animation: confirmFadeIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}

@keyframes confirmFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

.confirm-icon {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.confirm-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}

.confirm-card p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.confirm-buttons {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.btn-confirm-action {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  border: none;
}

.btn-confirm-yes {
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-primary);
}

.btn-confirm-yes:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.btn-confirm-no {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.btn-confirm-no:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Informações do Usuário na Sidebar */
.sidebar-user-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.user-avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.user-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.user-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.user-role {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Regras de impressão de recibos */
@media print {
  body.printing-receipt-mode {
    background: white !important;
    color: black !important;
  }
  body.printing-receipt-mode > *:not(#print-receipt-container) {
    display: none !important;
  }
  body.printing-receipt-mode #print-receipt-container {
    display: block !important;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: white !important;
    color: black !important;
    padding: 20px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  body.printing-receipt-mode table th, 
  body.printing-receipt-mode table td {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    color: black !important;
  }
}

#print-receipt-container {
  display: none;
}

.brand-text {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Outfit', 'Inter', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--gold-primary, #d4af37);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold-primary, #d4af37);
  word-break: break-word;
}

/* ==========================================
   ESTILOS PREMIUM DO ACERTO CONSIGNADO
   ========================================== */
.btn-excecoes-trigger:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 183, 77, 0.15) !important;
  border-color: #ffb74d !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 183, 77, 0.2);
}

.btn-shortcut-venda:hover {
  background: #2e7d32 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: #2e7d32 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.3);
}

.btn-shortcut-devolucao:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
}

.btn-input-adjust:hover {
  color: var(--gold-primary) !important;
}

/* ==========================================
   WIZARD DE ONBOARDING
   ========================================== */
#modal-onboarding-wizard .step-dot {
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
#modal-onboarding-wizard .step-dot.active {
  transform: scale(1.2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold-primary);
}
#modal-onboarding-wizard .wizard-step {
  animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ==========================================
   ABA DE TREINAMENTOS — MÓDULOS
   ========================================== */
.treinamento-modulos-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.modulo-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.18);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.modulo-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gold-gradient);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.modulo-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.45);
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.03);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 15px rgba(212,175,55,0.07);
}

.modulo-card:hover::before {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.modulo-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.modulo-icon-wrap {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.modulo-card:hover .modulo-icon-wrap {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,0.2);
}

.modulo-info h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.modulo-info p {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.modulo-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.18);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.modulo-badge.em-breve {
  background: rgba(100,100,100,0.08);
  border-color: rgba(100,100,100,0.2);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.modulo-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  padding-top: 0.8rem;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.modulo-btn-acessar {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.modulo-btn-acessar:hover {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.6);
}

.modulo-btn-acessar:disabled {
  opacity: 0.35;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Painel de vídeos do módulo selecionado */
.modulo-videos-painel {
  display: none;
  animation: fadeIn 0.35s ease;
}

.modulo-videos-painel.active {
  display: block;
}

.modulo-videos-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
}

.modulo-videos-header button {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.modulo-videos-header button:hover {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5);
}

.modulo-videos-header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--gold-light);
}

.video-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.2rem;
}

.video-item {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.video-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.35);
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.03);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.video-thumb {
  width: 80px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.video-thumb i {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.video-thumb img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.video-play-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

.video-item:hover .video-play-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.video-play-overlay i {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.video-meta {
  flex: 1;
}

.video-meta h4 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.video-meta p {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.video-duracao {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

/* Modal de vídeo */
#modal-video-player {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  z-index: 500;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

#modal-video-player.active {
  display: flex;
}

.video-player-card {
  background: #0d0d0d;
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 900px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.05);
}

.video-player-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.1);
}

.video-player-header h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  color: var(--gold-light);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.video-player-header button {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}

.video-player-header button:hover {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.video-player-body {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: 56.25%; /* 16:9 */
  background: #000;
}

.video-player-body iframe {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
}

/* ==========================================
   LINKS DE PAGAMENTO — MELHORIAS
   ========================================== */
.link-tipo-cliente-toggle {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.link-tipo-btn {
  flex: 1;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.22s;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.link-tipo-btn.active {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1);
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.4);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.link-tipo-btn:hover:not(.active) {
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.25);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.link-produto-item-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.link-produto-item-row select,
.link-produto-item-row input {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
}

.link-produto-item-row select { flex: 2; }
.link-produto-item-row input { flex: 1; width: 60px; }

.btn-remove-produto-link {
  background: rgba(198,40,40,0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(198,40,40,0.2);
  color: #ff8a80;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.btn-remove-produto-link:hover {
  background: #ef5350;
  color: #fff;
}

/* ==========================================
   ACERTO — BREAKDOWN POR FORMA DE PAGAMENTO
   ========================================== */
.acerto-breakdown-box {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: 0.8rem 0;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.acerto-breakdown-box h5 {
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.acerto-breakdown-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.acerto-breakdown-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

.acerto-breakdown-row strong {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.acerto-instrucao-box {
  background: rgba(100,181,246,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(100,181,246,0.2);
  border-left: 3px solid #64b5f6;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #a0c8e8;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
}

.acerto-instrucao-box i {
  color: #64b5f6;
  margin-right: 0.3rem;
}

.acerto-saldo-positivo { color: #81c784 !important; }
.acerto-saldo-negativo { color: #ef9a9a !important; }

/* ==========================================
   SINO DE NOTIFICAÇÕES — ANIMAÇÕES E ESTILOS
   ========================================== */

/* Animação de vibração do sino quando há notificações */
@keyframes bell-ring {
  0%   { transform: rotate(0); }
  5%   { transform: rotate(15deg); }
  10%  { transform: rotate(-15deg); }
  15%  { transform: rotate(15deg); }
  20%  { transform: rotate(-15deg); }
  25%  { transform: rotate(10deg); }
  30%  { transform: rotate(-10deg); }
  35%  { transform: rotate(6deg); }
  40%  { transform: rotate(-6deg); }
  45%  { transform: rotate(3deg); }
  50%  { transform: rotate(0); }
  100% { transform: rotate(0); }
}

@keyframes bell-glow-pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.1) inset; }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 18px rgba(212,175,55,0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.2) inset; }
}

#btn-notificacoes.tem-notif {
  animation: bell-glow-pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5);
}

#btn-notificacoes.tem-notif #icone-sino {
  animation: bell-ring 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin: top center;
  display: inline-block;
}

#btn-notificacoes:hover {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1) !important;
  border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.55) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.25) !important;
  transform: scale(1.06);
}

#notif-badge {
  animation: none;
}

#btn-notificacoes.tem-notif #notif-badge {
  display: flex !important;
}

/* Item individual de notificação */
.notif-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  cursor: default;
  transition: background 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.notif-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

.notif-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
}

.notif-item.nao-lida {
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.03);
}

.notif-item.nao-lida::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--gold-primary);
}

.notif-icone {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.notif-icone.info { background: rgba(100,181,246,0.12); color: #64b5f6; }
.notif-icone.warning { background: rgba(255,183,77,0.12); color: #ffb74d; }
.notif-icone.success { background: rgba(129,199,132,0.12); color: #81c784; }
.notif-icone.danger { background: rgba(239,154,154,0.12); color: #ef9a9a; }
.notif-icone.gold { background: rgba(212,175,55,0.12); color: var(--gold-primary); }

.notif-corpo h5 {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.notif-corpo p {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.notif-tempo {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  display: block;
}

/* ==========================================
   ESTILOS DO CICLO DE ACERTO
   ========================================== */

.ciclo-config-section {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ciclo-config-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.02);
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.ciclo-config-header:hover {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
}

/* Toggle Switch Premium */
.ciclo-toggle-switch {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 44px;
  height: 24px;
}

.ciclo-toggle-switch input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.ciclo-toggle-slider {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: .3s;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

.ciclo-toggle-slider:before {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  height: 16px;
  width: 16px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background-color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: .3s;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.ciclo-toggle-switch input:checked + .ciclo-toggle-slider {
  background-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
}

.ciclo-toggle-switch input:checked + .ciclo-toggle-slider:before {
  transform: translateX(20px);
  background-color: var(--gold-primary);
}

/* Badges de Estado do Ciclo */
.badge-ciclo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.badge-ciclo.em-andamento {
  background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.12);
  color: #4caf50;
  border: 1px solid rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.25);
}

.badge-ciclo.proximo {
  background: rgba(255, 152, 0, 0.12);
  color: #ff9800;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 152, 0, 0.25);
}

.badge-ciclo.janela-acerto {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
  animation: pulse-gold-border 2s infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-gold-border {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(212, 175, 55, 0); }
}

.badge-ciclo.prazo-vencido {
  background: rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.12);
  color: #f44336;
  border: 1px solid rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.25);
}

.badge-ciclo.sem-ciclo {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

/* Elementos visuais da Timeline do mês */
.timeline-dia {
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}

.timeline-dia.consignacao {
  background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.15);
}

.timeline-dia.acerto {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
}

.timeline-dia.hoje {
  background: var(--text-primary) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--text-primary);
  z-index: 10;
}

.timeline-dia.hoje::after {
  content: "Hoje";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -15px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ==========================================
   GALERIA DE TREINAMENTO PREMIUM (DISTRIBUIDORA)
   ========================================== */
.treinamento-modulos-grid {
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.modulo-premium-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.modulo-premium-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
}

.modulo-video-cover {
  height: 160px;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.modulo-video-cover.cover-1 {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(88, 28, 135, 0.7), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)), url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect width="100" height="100" fill="none"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="2" fill="none" opacity="0.1"/></svg>');
}
.modulo-video-cover.cover-2 {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.7), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)), url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect width="100" height="100" fill="none"/><path d="M10,10 L90,90 M90,10 L10,90" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="2" opacity="0.1"/></svg>');
}
.modulo-video-cover.cover-3 {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.7), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)), url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect width="100" height="100" fill="none"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" opacity="0.1"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="35" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" opacity="0.05"/></svg>');
}

.play-btn-glow {
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.9);
  color: #000;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  padding-left: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 2;
}

.modulo-premium-card:hover .play-btn-glow {
  transform: scale(1.15);
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.modulo-tag {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-gold);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.modulo-premium-content {
  padding: 1.2rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.modulo-premium-content h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.modulo-premium-content p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.modulo-premium-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: auto;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-top: 0.8rem;
}

.aula-duration {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.btn-assistir-aula {
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem !important;
  font-size: 0.78rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

/* ==========================================
   CORREÇÃO BUG 7: INPUT DE QUANTIDADE NOS BALÕES
   ========================================== */
.acerto-input-wrapper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.acerto-input-wrapper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  margin: 0;
}
.acerto-input-wrapper input[type=number] {
  -moz-appearance: textfield;
}

.acerto-input-wrapper input {
  padding: 0 !important;
  width: 35px !important;
  height: 28px !important;
  line-height: 28px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* ==========================================
   WIDGETS REORDENÁVEIS (MODO EDIÇÃO ESTILO iOS)
   ========================================== */
.widget-controls {
  display: none !important; /* Oculta por padrão no modo normal */
}

.edit-mode .widget-controls {
  display: flex !important; /* Exibe os botões apenas no modo de edição */
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes widgetWiggle {
  0% { transform: rotate(-0.8deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(0.8deg); }
  100% { transform: rotate(-0.8deg); }
}

.edit-mode .metric-card {
  animation: widgetWiggle 0.28s ease-in-out infinite;
  border: 1px dashed var(--gold-primary) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow) !important;
}

.edit-mode .metric-card:nth-child(even) {
  animation-duration: 0.31s;
  animation-delay: 0.05s;
}

.btn-edit-widgets {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  margin-left: 0.8rem;
}

.btn-edit-widgets.active {
  background: var(--gold-primary);
  color: #000 !important;
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.btn-edit-widgets:hover {
  transform: scale(1.08);
  border-color: var(--gold-primary);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   SISTEMA DE RESPONSIVIDADE GLOBAL (MOBILE, TABLET, DESKTOP)
   ========================================================================== */

/* Utility classes para controle de visibilidade por dispositivo */
.show-mobile { display: none !important; }
.show-tablet { display: none !important; }
.hide-mobile { display: block !important; }

/* Barra Superior Mobile (Top Header com Hambúrguer) */
.mobile-top-bar {
  display: none;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 1001;
  background-color: var(--bg-absolute);
  border-bottom: var(--border-gold);
  padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}

.mobile-top-bar .mobile-brand {
  height: 32px;
  width: auto;
}

.btn-mobile-toggle {
  background: transparent;
  border: var(--border-gold);
  color: var(--gold-primary);
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-mobile-toggle:hover,
.btn-mobile-toggle:active {
  background: var(--gold-translucent);
  color: var(--gold-light);
}

/* Overlay Escuro para Mobile Drawer */
.sidebar-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  z-index: 1045;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.sidebar-overlay.active {
  display: block;
  opacity: 1;
}

/* --- BREAKPOINT: TABLET & DESKTOP PEQUENO (max-width: 992px) --- */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .show-tablet { display: block !important; }
  
  /* Layout principal em coluna */
  .app-container {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .main-content {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* Ajustes em Grids e Layouts de duas colunas */
  .dashboard-grid,
  .split-layout,
  .form-grid,
  .feed-planner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    gap: 1.25rem !important;
  }

  .metrics-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 1rem !important;
  }

  .metric-card {
    padding: 1.2rem !important;
  }

  .metric-icon {
    width: 48px !important;
    height: 48px !important;
    font-size: 1.4rem !important;
  }

  .metric-info .metric-value {
    font-size: 1.4rem !important;
  }
}

/* --- BREAKPOINT: MOBILE (max-width: 768px) --- */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .show-mobile { display: flex !important; }
  .hide-mobile { display: none !important; }
  .mobile-top-bar { display: flex !important; }

  /* Drawer Off-canvas para a Sidebar */
  .sidebar.mobile-drawer {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: -300px !important;
    width: 280px !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    z-index: 1050 !important;
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
    box-shadow: 10px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) !important;
  }

  .sidebar.mobile-drawer.active,
  body.sidebar-open .sidebar.mobile-drawer {
    transform: translateX(300px) !important;
  }

  /* Cabeçalhos de Seção */
  .section-header {
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: flex-start !important;
    gap: 0.8rem !important;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
    padding-bottom: 1rem !important;
  }

  .section-title h1 {
    font-size: 1.6rem !important;
  }

  .section-title p {
    font-size: 0.85rem !important;
  }

  /* Botões com Touch Target Adequado em Mobile */
  .btn-gold, .btn-outline-gold, .btn-danger, .btn-danger-outline {
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .section-header .btn-gold, 
  .section-header .btn-outline-gold {
    width: 100%;
  }

  /* Grids em 1 Coluna para Celular */
  .metrics-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }

  /* Modais em Telas de Celular */
  .modal-dialog,
  .modal-content,
  .modal-container {
    width: 95vw !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 10px auto !important;
    padding: 1.2rem !important;
    max-height: 90vh !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md) !important;
  }

  /* Tabelas Responsivas Touch */
  .table-responsive {
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: auto !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .premium-table th, 
  .premium-table td {
    padding: 0.6rem 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.78rem !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Mockup Instagram Responsivo */
  .instagram-mockup {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 350px !important;
    border-radius: 24px !important;
    padding: 1.5rem 0.8rem !important;
  }
}

/* --- BREAKPOINT: MOBILE PEQUENO (max-width: 480px) --- */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  body {
    font-size: 14px !important;
  }

  .main-content {
    padding: 1rem 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .section-title h1 {
    font-size: 1.4rem !important;
  }

  .metric-card {
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 1rem !important;
    padding: 1rem !important;
  }

  .metric-info .metric-value {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
  }

  /* Inputs com toque facilitado */
  .form-control, select, textarea {
    font-size: 16px !important; /* Evita auto-zoom no iOS Safari */
    padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem !important;
    min-height: 44px;
  }

  /* Login Card & Wizard Responsivos */
  .login-card,
  #onboarding-wizard-card {
    width: 94vw !important;
    max-width: 440px !important;
    padding: 1.5rem 1.2rem !important;
    margin: 10px auto !important;
  }
}

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <title>Conecta Joias SaaS - Painel de Controle Global</title>
  
  <!-- Script de Segurança Preventivo Inline -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      const token = localStorage.getItem("conectajoias_token");
      const usuarioJson = localStorage.getItem("conectajoias_usuario");
      if (!token || !usuarioJson) {
        window.location.href = "login.html";
        return;
      }
      try {
        const usuario = JSON.parse(usuarioJson);
        if (usuario.role !== "SuperAdmin") {
          // Se não for SuperAdmin, expulsa
          window.location.href = "login.html";
        }
      } catch (e) {
        localStorage.clear();
        window.location.href = "login.html";
      }
    })();
  </script>
